facts.name: Document reader
facts.described_as: Fetch the content of ONE specific project document by document_id or filename. Use this when the user refers to a specific or attached file. For open-ended questions across the corpus use search_project_documents instead.

inputs.name: document_id
inputs.label: document id
inputs.described_as: The document id (preferred when known, e.g. from an attachment note or a prior search result).

inputs.name: filename
inputs.label: file name
inputs.described_as: The document's original filename (used when the id is not known).

hints.purpose: Reads the text of one document, picked by its id or file name, from this project or a library a search cites. One call returns the text up to a fixed length, with truncated saying whether the end was cut and partial_read when only part of a scan was read. A name that matches several documents returns an error naming them all, not a pick.

not_to_be_confused_with.difference: That one finds ranked passages across every document; this one returns the text of a single document.
That one lists the documents the project holds without reading any of them.

question_kinds.how: Use it when the question names the document; for a passage in an unnamed document search first. A long document comes back cut at a fixed length, with truncated set.
The text of a bill is not its rows: a count or total over bill rows comes from the bill row tool.
Reads the named specification or bill whole when a searched passage cuts off the clause or item the question needs.
Reads the named drawing or specification whole when a searched passage is not enough to join the two.
